title: RES-CNN-BILSTM NETWORK FOR OVERCOMING MENTAL HEALTH DISTURBANCES CAUSED DUE TO CYBERBULLYING THROUGH SOCIAL MEDIA
reasoning: The paper focuses on detecting cyberbullying on social media using deep learning. While it identifies 'religion' as one of the key categories of cyberbullying used for classification, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems themselves. The study is a technical performance evaluation of a classifier rather than an inquiry into faith or ethics.
